_comment: Where the page enrichers fetch from, and how politely.
One file rather than one block per enricher, because three copies of a
throttle value drift and the wiki is a volunteer community resource — being
impolite to it is both rude and the fastest route to being blocked.
Cargo tables are fetched separately (curated/vocab/cargo_tables.json); this
covers `action=raw` page reads and the revisions API.
CI never touches the wiki. sources/ is committed so builds are hermetic.
